criterion: Labels/copy: misleading / One way per task
description: The Activity "Goals and veins" filter excludes every goal and vein status verdict (Proven, Dead end, Achieved…). Those are filed under "Status changes and handoffs", mixed with task moves. A user building a plan digest concludes the verdicts were not saved.
expected: Goals and veins includes goal and vein status changes (an event can belong to both groups), or the filter is renamed to say it excludes status.
actual: Goals and veins: 21 rows, 0 verdicts. Status changes: 15 verdicts and 7 task moves.
suggested_fix: Let eventGroup return several groups and match goal/vein status updates under both filters.

description: Activity's Show and Performed by filters reset to All changes / Any Actor on reload, while the board's Assigned to / Status / Vein filters persist per project.
expected: Both views persist filters the same way.
actual: Activity filters are lost on reload.
suggested_fix: Store activityShow and activityActor in the same savePreferences call as the board filters.

description: Performed by lists three identical "Setup agent · agent" options (one per client), so it is impossible to choose a particular agent.
expected: Distinguishable agent labels (owner, harness or handle).
suggested_fix: Append the owning person or handle to agent labels in Actor selects.
